subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses consonant blends to build up and break down words (sp-o-t, fr-o-g, dr-i-nk, st-i-ck)

show.line: Blends that start with s! sp, sp, spot. st, st, stick. sn, sn, snap.

rounds.prompt: Listen. sp, o, t. What word is it?
Which one starts with st, as in stick?
Say the blend with me. sn, as in snap!
Listen. st, e, p. Tap the word.
Which one starts with sp, as in spot?
Does it start with sp, st or sn? Sort the pictures.

hints: Start with s, then the next sound fast. s, t. st!
Listen to the second sound. p, t or n?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with st.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Snail starts with sn. Star starts with st.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. st, st, star. Star starts with st!

parent_line: Can hear and blend the s blends sp, st and sn.
